root_cause: WEBHOOK_URL on /frisse-blik was an empty string; the form sent nothing while still showing the booking step, so leads were lost without error.
fix: WEBHOOK_URL points to the Supabase Edge Function lead-intake (verify_jwt false, origin allow-list, validation, idempotency key, stores into commercial_leads).
prevention_rule: A form that reports success must have a verified server endpoint; an empty endpoint must fail visibly.

invariants: no service secret in the public page
live_readback: one real submission on the live page creates one commercial_leads row
